case: Persistent Piper file becomes visible before writing completes
fake_piper_source:
#!/usr/bin/python3
import sys,time,pathlib,struct
folder=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('-d')+1])
for index,line in enumerate(sys.stdin):
    data=bytes(22050*2)
    header=struct.pack('<4sI4s4sIHHIIHH4sI',b'RIFF',36+len(data),b'WAVE',b'fmt ',16,1,1,22050,44100,2,16,b'data',len(data))
    with (folder/f'{index}.wav').open('wb') as output:
        output.write(header+data[:4096]); output.flush()
        time.sleep(0.5)
        output.write(data[4096:]); output.flush()
